content.short: STRATO is a precious-metals-backed DeFi platform with bridging and stablecoin borrowing.
content.description: STRATO backs its DeFi platform with precious metals, letting users bridge crypto in and borrow stablecoins against metal-backed collateral on Robinhood Chain. Gold-backed collateral sits oddly alongside crypto lending but appeals to the same instinct as tokenized Treasuries: collateral whose value does not move with the rest of the portfolio.
